subject.statement: Greg Abel is currently the CEO of Berkshire Hathaway.

summary: As of 2026-10-01, Warren Buffett remains the CEO of Berkshire Hathaway; Greg Abel holds the title of Vice Chairman and is the designated successor but has not yet assumed the CEO role.
